title: 第1章 侠客系统

content_zh:
火红的初阳，像是一盏冉冉升起的扁圆宫灯，它喷射出万道金光，俯照山河大地。
七月的京城比往年凉快了许多，不像前几年那般炎热不堪。
锦衣卫‘明时坊’百户所今日格外的热闹，十数位身着飞鱼服的锦衣校尉站在百户所内的广场上勾肩搭背、有说有笑，丝毫没有厂卫该有的那份庄严肃穆。
广场很大，长宽面积足有三十余丈，场内陈放着各式各样的兵器，刀枪剑戟、斧钺钩叉应有尽有，但最多的还是‘刀’。
这是一所练武场，专供明时坊百户所的锦衣卫训练，只是这诺大的练武场却只有两三个人在苦练，其他人只是笑语欢声，言语间尽是**勾栏。
踏!踏!踏！
一阵响亮的脚步声渐行渐近，却并未影响到谈笑风声的校尉们。
锦衣卫百户沈炼面无表情的走进练武场，陪同他的是锦衣卫小旗殷澄。
“这些都是昨天刚补进来的？”沈炼环抱着双臂，绣春刀夹在臂弯中，英俊的脸上满是冷酷之色，一双犀利的眼睛冷冷的盯着身边的殷澄。
“是的大人！”殷澄小心翼翼的道，他看向沈炼的眼睛里有着一丝畏惧。
沈炼冷着脸扫过谈笑的校尉们，也没做什么动作，他只不过随口一问罢了，他只想做好他的百户，其他人无论做什么都和他没有任何关系。
“这些人大多是上面收了黑钱送过来的少爷兵，大人也可以赚上一笔......”殷澄倒是误会了沈炼的意思，他以为沈炼是厌恶这些人，于是他小声对沈炼说道。
只不过他尚未说完，就被沈炼打断了，沈炼道：“闭嘴，莫要胡说八道......“
殷澄讪讪笑了笑，他明白自己说多了，他平时没少因为嘴快跟人发生争执，可是这个毛病却一直不曾改掉。
“大人不要只关注这些人，咱们百户所这一次还是补进了不少卫所子弟的。”殷澄为了缓解方才的尴尬，指了指那几个在训练的锦衣校尉。
“那个举石头的汉子叫肖扬，是咱们卫所老肖的儿子！”
“隔壁卫所老赵的儿子倒是一把好手，练刀的那个汉子就是！”
“这个做......”殷澄嘴角抽了抽，他手指的第三人此刻正做着一种莫名其妙的动作，只见他两手支撑着地面，身躯一起一伏，毫不雅观，他旁边还有几位锦衣校尉对他的动作指指点点。
“这个做‘不雅’动作的也是子承父业补进来的，他爹叫沈一高以前是咱们卫所的一名总旗，后来被派往广州公干，一去就是十余年，前段时间沈一高客死异乡，他儿子就变卖家财从新回到了京城，补了一个校尉的缺。“
“你说他爹叫沈一高？”殷澄介绍前两人时沈炼一直面无表情，不过当殷澄说起沈一高时沈炼的眼皮不经意间跳动了一下。

“是啊，他爹叫沈一高，他叫沈长青。”殷澄说道。
听到殷澄的回答，沈炼的嘴角浮现出一丝笑意，这让殷澄很意外，自从他进入明时坊百户所以来，还没见百户大人笑过几次，今天他居然莫名笑了！
“殷小旗好......”
有人发现了站在门口的沈炼二人连忙打招呼，其他人自然也被惊动了，也都忙向殷澄问好。
啪！啪！
殷澄拍了两下手掌，示意众人肃静，同时一脸尊重的指着沈炼介绍道：“这是咱们百户所的沈百户，前几日外出办差你们还未见过，还不赶紧过来拜见！”
“见过百户大人。”众人连忙弯腰拜见，锦衣卫百户可是正六品的官衔，比普通的知县还要高两级，更何况锦衣卫还是天子亲军。
他们这些花钱进来的，虽说家里有些钱财，却远远比不了锦衣卫百户官，明朝商人的地位可着实不高！
沈炼只是微微点了下头，英俊的脸上依旧面无表情，他冷峻的目光扫过众校尉，落在了众人身后那名叫做沈长青的校尉身上。
众人的也随着他的目光转身看去，下一刻无不骇然，沈长青居然无视了他们的百户官，依然在地上趴着做着那不雅观的动作。
锦衣卫可是很讲究尊卑贵贱的一个系统，在场之人无不为沈长青捏了一把汗，当然也有人在幸灾乐祸。
“他妈......”殷澄立时就要训斥，却见沈炼做了一个噤声的手势。
沈炼没有说话，他径直走向了沈长青的位置，殷澄有些好奇的走在沈炼身后，众人自发让出一条通道。

content_en:
The fiery red early sun is like a rising oblate palace lantern. It shoots out thousands of golden lights and shines down on the mountains, rivers and earth.
The capital city in July is much cooler than in previous years, and it is not as hot as in previous years.
Jinyiwei's Mingshifang Hundred Households Office was particularly lively today. A dozen Jinyi captains wearing flying fish uniforms stood on the square in the Hundred Households Office arm-in-arms, chatting and laughing, without the solemnity that a factory guard should have.
The square is very large, with a length and width of more than thirty feet. There are all kinds of weapons on display in the square, including swords, guns, swords, halberds, axes, axes, hooks and forks, but the most numerous ones are 'knives'.
This is a martial arts training ground, specially for the training of the Jin Yiwei of Mingshifang Baihu Institute. However, in this large martial arts training ground, there are only two or three people practicing hard. The others are just laughing and cheering, and their words are full of sexual hooks.
Tread! Tread! Tread!
A burst of loud footsteps gradually approached, but it did not affect the captains who were chatting and laughing.
Jinyiwei Baihu Shen Lian walked into the martial arts training ground expressionlessly, accompanied by Jinyiwei Xiaoqi Yin Cheng.
"Were these just added yesterday?" Shen Lian crossed his arms and held the embroidered spring knife in his arms. His handsome face was full of coldness, and his sharp eyes stared coldly at Yin Cheng beside him.
"Yes, sir!" Yin Cheng said cautiously, with a hint of fear in his eyes when he looked at Shen Lian.
Shen Lian glanced at the chatting and laughing captains with a cold face, and did not make any move. He just asked casually. He just wanted to be a good member of his family, and no matter what others did, it had nothing to do with him.
"Most of these people are young master soldiers sent here with black money. You can also make a fortune..." Yin Cheng misunderstood what Shen Lian meant. He thought Shen Lian hated these people, so he whispered to Shen Lian.
But before he finished speaking, he was interrupted by Shen Lian, who said: "Shut up, don't talk nonsense..."
Yin Cheng smiled sheepishly. He understood that he talked too much. He usually got into arguments with people because of his quick words, but he never got rid of this problem.
"Sir, please don't just pay attention to these people. Our Baihu Institute has recruited a lot of young people from the guard station this time." In order to ease the embarrassment just now, Yin Cheng pointed to the few Jinyi captains who were training.
"The man who lifted the stone is called Xiao Yang, and he is the son of Lao Xiao from our health center!"
"Old Zhao's son from the guard house next door is a good swordsman, and that's the man who practices swordsmanship!"
"Do this..." The corner of Yin Cheng's mouth twitched. The third person he pointed at was making an inexplicable movement at the moment. He was supporting the ground with both hands, and his body was rising and falling together. It was not elegant. There were several captains in Jinyi beside him pointing at his movements.
"The person who did the 'indecent' act was also inherited from his father. His father, Shen Yigao, used to be a commander-in-chief of our health center. He was later sent to Guangzhou for more than ten years. Some time ago, Shen Yigao died in a foreign country. His son sold his property and returned to the capital to fill the vacancy of a school captain."
"You said his father's name is Shen Yigao?" Shen Lian remained expressionless when Yin Cheng introduced the first two people, but when Yin Cheng mentioned Shen Yigao, Shen Lian's eyelids twitched inadvertently.
"Yes, his father's name is Shen Yigao, and his name is Shen Changqing." Yin Cheng said.
Hearing Yin Cheng's answer, a smile appeared on the corner of Shen Lian's mouth, which surprised Yin Cheng. Since he entered Baihu in Mingshifang, he has never seen Master Baihu smile a few times. Today he actually smiled inexplicably!
"Hello Yin Xiaoqi..."
Someone noticed Shen Lian and his wife standing at the door and quickly said hello. Others were naturally alerted and rushed to say hello to Yin Cheng.
Snap! Snap!
Yin Cheng clapped his palms twice to signal everyone to be silent. At the same time, he pointed at Shen Lian with respect and introduced: "This is Shen Baihu from our Baihu Office. You haven't seen him before when he was out on business a few days ago.Why don't you come over and see me quickly! "
“I’ve met Mr. Baihu. "Everyone hurriedly bent down to pay their respects. Jinyiwei Baihu has an official rank of the sixth rank, which is two levels higher than an ordinary magistrate. What's more, Jinyiwei is also a personal soldier of the emperor.
Although these people who spent money to come in have some money at home, they are far inferior to the officials of the Hundred Households of Jinyiwei. The status of merchants in the Ming Dynasty was really not high!
Shen Lian just nodded slightly, his handsome face still expressionless. His stern eyes swept across the captains and landed on the captain named Shen Changqing behind them.
Everyone also followed his gaze and turned to look. The next moment, they were all shocked. Shen Changqing actually ignored their Bai Huguan and was still lying on the ground doing the indecent movements.
Jinyiwei is a system that emphasizes the importance of superiority and inferiority. Everyone present was sweating for Shen Changqing, and of course some were gloating about his misfortune.
"Fuck..." Yin Cheng was about to reprimand, but saw Shen Lian making a silent gesture.
Shen Lian didn't say anything. He walked straight to Shen Changqing's position. Yin Cheng walked behind Shen Lian with some curiosity, and everyone spontaneously made way for a passage.
